title: connectome2tck
description:
Extract streamlines from a tractogram based on their assignment to parcellated nodes.

The compulsory input file "assignments_in" should contain a text file where there is one row for each streamline, and each row contains a list of numbers corresponding to the parcels to which that streamline was assigned (most typically there will be two entries per streamline, one for each endpoint; but this is not strictly a requirement). This file will most typically be generated using the tck2connectome command with the -out_assignments option.

References:

nodes.description: only select tracks that involve a set of nodes of interest (provide as a comma-separated list of integers)
nodes.title: nodes

exclusive.description: only select tracks that exclusively connect nodes from within the list of nodes of interest
exclusive.title: exclusive

files.description: select how the resulting streamlines will be grouped in output files. Options are: per_edge, per_node, single (default: per_edge)
files.title: files

exemplars.description: generate a mean connection exemplar per edge, rather than keeping all streamlines (the parcellation node image must be provided in order to constrain the exemplar endpoints)
exemplars.title: exemplars

keep_unassigned.description: by default, the program discards those streamlines that are not successfully assigned to a node. Set this option to generate corresponding outputs containing these streamlines (labelled as node index 0)
keep_unassigned.title: keep_unassigned

keep_self.description: by default, the program will not output streamlines that connect to the same node at both ends. Set this option to instead keep these self-connections.
keep_self.title: keep_self

tck_weights_in.description: specify a text scalar file containing the streamline weights
tck_weights_in.title: tck_weights_in

prefix_tck_weights_out.description: provide a prefix for outputting a text file corresponding to each output file, each containing only the streamline weights relevant for that track file
prefix_tck_weights_out.title: prefix_tck_weights_out

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
